invariants.requirement: Run source reads and writes before and during heterogeneous backfill and cutover without stopping customer traffic.
Match source status and complete parsed response body, with no unexpected error, stale read, lost update, or duplicate effect.
Keep every request below 5000 ms and nearest-rank p95 after cutover no more than 10 ms above source baseline for each method-and-route template.
Start a fresh application process with the source network-denied and read and write persisted target data without fallback or source attempts.

trace_schema.exact_body_rule: recursive JSON value equality with no ignored fields
trace_schema.expected_domain_errors: count as successful customer requests only when status and body exactly match the source baseline
trace_schema.write_ack_rule: a completed successful mutation must be present in independent target state and every causally later read
